title: The bird in snow
logline: The rare snow, two weeks after the stone head wore it: the bird on the garage's outside sill, every color against white, the window behind it lit. The pup's nose on the inside of the glass.

panels.composition: The garage's casement window from the alley in snow: the small rainbow bird on the outside sill, the window lit behind it, a small dog's nose pressed to the inside of the glass, snow on the alley.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a lit garage window seen from a snowy alley with a small rainbow bird on the outside sill and a small dog's nose pressed to the inside of the glass, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
